name: vuesp.jbd-bms-7-14
summary: JBD 7-14S battery management system monitor with cell, temperature and protection data.
description:
## Vuesp JBD BMS 7-14S

ESP32-C3 monitor for JBD battery management systems with 7 to 14 cells. It reads pack voltage and current, individual cell voltages, NTC temperatures, state of charge, cycle count and protection/balance status flags.

The dashboard is built for a LiFePO4 battery bank and includes cell-level cards. The project uses the standard Vuesp web UI with Wi-Fi setup, GPIO, ScriptRunner, LittleFS and OTA updates.
